## About
We are an auto body shop and collision center on Venice Blvd. in Los Angeles. We do auto body repair and car painting, and we specialize in foreign cars. Whether you drive a luxury car or an economy car, we fix it with the same care.
Accidents happen, whether it was your fault or someone else's. Having your car repaired is inconvenient, so we try to keep the hassle low and return your vehicle to its pre-loss condition. We want you happy with the repair and with how you were treated along the way.
Neighbors rate us 4.9 from 74 Google reviews. Reviewers often mention Payam and Andrew by name, and they tell us they appreciate straight answers and fair prices.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Body work that aims to bring your car back to its pre-loss condition.
- Car painting: Paint work so the finished panels match the rest of the car.
- Foreign cars: Foreign cars are our specialty.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance?
A: Yes. We are insurance friendly. Drop your vehicle at our shop and we will handle the rest.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Foreign cars are our specialty.
